desc: The ShedHorn is the perfect choice for sidelock enthusiasts and those who are looking for an affordable sidelock rifle for a particular season in their state! While still primitive, the ShedHorn is equipped with many modern features that make this muzzleloader more accurate and user friendly. The chromoly steel barrel keep the ShedHorn lightweight and easy to carry while the 1:28" twist allows you to fire saboted bullets and modern muzzleloading projectiles. The Accelerator Breech Plug can be removed by hand and the Premium CeraKote Finish helps to protect against weather and corrosion. The ShedHorn is also drilled and tapped for a scope. The ShedHorn can fire loose black powder or Pyrodex and features a musket cap ignition. With a double set trigger and Williams Fiber Optic sights, the ShedHorn is feature-rich, yet affordable, for those looking for a lightweight, accurate sidelock muzzleloader.
